card.name: Digit 0 inside ISSN and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 in the middle of an ISSN, ISBN or DOI number in a reference citation. It follows a few other digits and hyphens.

modes.label: ISSN digit
modes.description: A zero inside an ISSN number in a journal citation.

modes.label: ISBN digit
modes.description: A zero inside an ISBN number in a book citation.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; it seems to hold back number-like or Chinese-count continuations.
card.plain: It fires on a zero in the middle of a book or journal ID number in a reference list.
